decisions.reason: As the publicly showcased flagship of the firm's announced direction, transactional email carries heavy investment and visible commitment, so dropping it would expose the earlier strategic decision as a mistake.
Managed capture has its own page, a cited customer success and fits the digital document workflow strategy, so management will persist with it and attribute any weakness to temporary adoption delays.
The email and fax conversion service builds on the firm's core messaging infrastructure at low ongoing cost and supports regulated multichannel customers, so there is little reason to write it off.

This low-investment feature sits close to the established fax business and is only mentioned, not championed, so it is easier to drop than the others, but fax remains relevant in regulated German sectors and it costs little to keep.

Sandbox threat protection is part of the email security suite the firm keeps promoting, and having already dropped the multi-engine scanner, management is likely to consolidate around this offering rather than abandon it.
